text_block_list.text:
One day in the morning.
As I happened to walk past the academy's fields—

text_block_list.name: Sports Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Has everyone gotten into groups of four?
Now, work together and cultivate one plot each.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Um, shall we start with weeding first, then?
...It feels like a pretty monotonous task to do in silence, though.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If we divide up the roles properly,
it'll be done in no time!
Let's give it our all at a hundred miles an hour!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Carefully, meticulously...
Five miles of power each, distributed evenly!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Alright. U-Um...
I've finished clearing the stones... from around here too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Then, I'll till the soil over here—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-san? Is something the matter?
Could it be that you're not feeling well—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh, no way!!
I can't concentrate at all~~!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: My brain is so boooored~~!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I'm hopeless...!
I'm so, so bad at simple tasks like this~~!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Ah.
C-Come to think of it... Love-chan always—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Whether drying hair or brushing teeth...
she's playing puzzle games at the same time, aren't they...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Having an idle mind
just makes me so restless...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, I'm so restless!
Doesn't anyone have a task for me?!
Give me a task, pleeease!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —How many miles high is Mt. Fuji!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I-I see... If it's while
solving math problems...
it becomes multitasking, doesn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Um, well then—!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
When Calstone Light O set the record on the Niigata 1000m straight,
her final three furlongs were 31.9 seconds.
What is that converted to kilometers per hour?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: In that case, I will too. Um...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
All offspring from pure-breeding red and white flowers were red.
If self-pollination continues, what will be the ratio
of flower colors in the 'great-grandchild' generation?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Red and white—5 to 3!
Looking good... looking really good...!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"What is the average speed of the record-breaking 2:10.1 time set at the Takarazuka Kinen?
And what about the 2:29.5 Arima Kinen record?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Takarazuka Kinen: approx. 60.9 km!
Arima Kinen: approx. 60.2 km—!!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: All right, then the next question is—

text_block_list.name: Sports Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Gran-san, Chrono-san, Bouquet-san!
Your hands have stopped moving.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! S-Sorry!
I got so caught up in asking questions...

text_block_list.name: Sports Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text: It's wonderful that you get along so well, but if you do nothing but chat, the work won't—oh?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"—Phew~~ I really feel most at ease
when my mind is engaged♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, all done plowing!
Great job, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh, all of it in this short amount of time!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks to Gran-chan and the others
giving me so many practice problems,
I made a ton of progress♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So please, Teacher, don't scold
the three of them.
This is just how we split up our roles♡

text_block_list.name: Sports Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...R-Right... Yes, as long as
you properly worked together to till it, it's fine.
...Is it really fine, though?

Turning it into a multitask seems to have caused
her concentration and processing speed to explode.
It's quite a tricky way to divide the workload, though...
choice_data_list: Is this the ultimate division of labor...?
Is this the ultimate division of labor... I wonder?

text_block_list.text:
Turning it into a multitask seems to have caused
her concentration and processing speed to explode.
It's quite a tricky way to divide the workload, though...
choice_data_list: Is this the ultimate division of labor...?
Is this the ultimate division of labor... I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, that was 100-mile-an-hour
teamwork, wasn't it!
Coming up with the questions was so fun, too~!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I also... k-kind of got carried away with the fun
and went a bit overboard...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No worries at all!
Since we're working together anyway,
the best thing is for everyone to have fun while doing it, right?♡

I was a bit concerned that nobody called out her bizarre quirk
of being blazingly fast only when multitasking...
Regardless, I'm glad she seems to be enjoying class.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: However, I ended up leaving almost all the work to Loves. I feel a bit guilty about it...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Still, if Bouquet-chan hadn't quizzed me, I would've been the one slacking off, wouldn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The plant genetics problem was simple, but there was
so much data to process—it was so, so fun. Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—!
I'm glad you enjoyed it.
Fufu... It's our special division of roles, isn't it?
